The north shore of Erewhon's lake: the fifth region of sites (settlements/pher/PLAN.md step P2): the lake's north shore from Phēr east to Ḍāiyar, the rim plain and the Qol Siṭrīm's valley up to Thalaba on map 5.1 at 1:1 (500 m cells) on core/world, the Xanadu kit on its overlay, Phēr's headland and point as landform records and its stream; Phēr's six farming villages on core/hamlet's xanadu row (XAK) and the Thalaba road up the Qol valley with its hans and bridges.
